findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, list_templates, contact, get_api_x402_check · Private data: list_plans, buy_plan, create_guest, create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, get_endpoint, ping_ingest, signal_start, signal_fail, signal_exit_code, status_feed_url, status_feed_rotate, contact · Public sink: cancel_plan, create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, signal_slug, contact · Destructive: create_endpoint, create_site, get_endpoint, delete_endpoint, signal_start, signal_fail, status_feed_url, list_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, list_templates, contact, get_api_x402_check · Private data: list_plans, buy_plan, create_guest, create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, get_endpoint, ping_ingest, signal_start, signal_fail, signal_exit_code, status_feed_url, status_feed_rotate, contact · Public sink: cancel_plan, create_endpoint, create_site, import_crontab, signal_start, signal_fail, ping_slug, signal_slug, contact · Destructive: create_endpoint, create_site, get_endpoint, delete_endpoint, signal_start, signal_fail, status_feed_url, list_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
